curatorship.title: What is financial curatorship?
curatorship.intro: Financial curatorship means regular support for a specific cat. You don't just send money "somewhere" — you become a guardian of a living soul with a name, personality, and story.

choose.title: Choose a cat
choose.description: Browse the catalog, read their story, and find the one that speaks to you.

support.title: Support monthly
support.description: A fixed contribution covers food, medicine, and care for your sponsored cat.

connect.title: Stay connected
connect.description: Receive news, photos, and updates about your cat — on the website and via Telegram.

curatorship.note: Connection first. Then financial support that saves lives.

funds.title: Where do shelter funds go?
funds.intro: Every hryvnia goes to real animal needs. We publish reports and show exactly how donations are used.

food.title: Food & nutrition
food.description: Quality food, treats, and special diets for cats with specific needs.

vet.description: Vaccinations, sterilization, treatment, tests, and emergency surgery.

care.description: Litter, hygiene supplies, toys, carriers, and shelter equipment.

shelter.description: Rent, utilities, transportation, staff salaries, and other essential costs that keep the shelter running and ensure our cats receive daily care
